Hookgres

Webhooks that commit
with your data.

A TypeScript library that queues webhooks in your Postgres transaction, then signs, retries and logs every delivery.

AgentAdd Hookgres webhooks to this app: hookgres.dev/llms.txt
npm$ npm install hookgres pg
app.tsreceiver.ts
await client.query("BEGIN");
await client.query("UPDATE invoices …");

// Sent only if this transaction commits
await hookgres.send({
  tenantId: "acme",
  eventType: "invoice.paid",
  payload: { invoiceId: "in_123" },
}, { client });

await client.query("COMMIT");
